trials.claim: Lifetime access to SearchIQ on Startup Package Plan
trials.claimQuote:
### SearchIQ Startup Package Plan: $39 (was $228)
- Lifetime access to SearchIQ
- You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let SearchIQ discontinue or change the service at any time and terminate the agreement at its sole discretion for any reason, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Search IQ reserves the right to discontinue, modify, and change the Service at any time, with or without notice to you.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor can discontinue or change the service at any time without notice.

exhibits.quote: Search IQ reserves the right at any time, and without cost, charge or liability, to terminate this EULA at its sole discretion for any reason, including, but not limited to, a failure to comply with the terms of this EULA.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is revocable because the vendor can terminate the agreement at its sole discretion for any reason.

trials.reasoning: Vendor pricing lists Unlimited Domains and a buyer confirms use on many websites; the prosecution exhibits concern service changes generally and faceted search, not domains.

exhibits.quote: Search IQ reserves the right to discontinue, modify, and change the Service at any time, with or without notice to you.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited domains is not guaranteed because the vendor can discontinue or modify the service without notice.

- Unlimited Domains

exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing lists Unlimited Domains as an included feature.

exhibits.quote: It is fast and you can use it on many websites. 5/5 Recommended. Thank you for the search app.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product can be used on many websites.

trials.claimQuote:
- Only for new SearchIQ users who do not have existing accounts
- 5,000 Documents
- For additional Documents, partner is doing $20 per 5,000 Documents yearly
trials.reasoning: The exhibit only shows another tier includes 10,000 documents; it does not show what deal buyers actually receive or contradict that they receive 5,000.

exhibits.quote:
- 10,000 Documents

- Unlimited Queries

- Self-Service Support

- 24 Hour Analytics
exhibits.argument: 5,000 documents is undermined because the free tier includes 10,000 documents, more than the paid deal.

trials.claimQuote:
- For additional Documents, partner is doing $20 per 5,000 Documents yearly
- 1 Month of analytics
- Cross-domain search
trials.reasoning: Reviews saying analytics retention should be longer do not prove or disprove that the deal includes exactly 1 month of analytics, and no defense exhibit confirms it.

exhibits.quote: The analytics do have real limitations though. They need longer data retention, better historical reporting, and internal traffic filtering.
exhibits.argument: 1 month of analytics is inadequate because a buyer reports it needs longer retention and better historical reporting.

exhibits.quote: I flagged the last one to the team six months ago and it has not been implemented yet, which also raises questions about the pace of active development.
exhibits.argument: Analytics limitations persist because a requested improvement was not implemented after six months.

trials.claimQuote:
- You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
- Please note: This deal is not stackable
trials.reasoning: The vendor says features are continually updated and a buyer confirms many updates have been pushed since purchase; the prosecution exhibits do not show deal buyers were excluded from updates.

exhibits.quote: Search IQ reserves the right to discontinue, modify, and change the Service at any time, with or without notice to you.
exhibits.argument: Future updates are not guaranteed because the vendor can discontinue or change the service at any time.

exhibits.quote: I flagged the last one to the team six months ago and it has not been implemented yet, which also raises questions about the pace of active development.
exhibits.argument: Future updates are doubtful because a buyer reports requested improvements were not implemented.

exhibits.quote: Our industry-leading features are continually updated with the latest advancements in search technology.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its features are continually updated.

exhibits.quote: Many updated have been pushed since I bought it which indicate the software is well maintained.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms updates have been pushed since purchase.

trials.reasoning: The binding terms state fees are non-refundable and there will be no refunds or credits, directly conflicting with the advertised 60-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: The Monthly Fee will be billed in advance for each period and is non-refundable.
exhibits.argument: Money-back guarantee is contradicted by vendor terms stating fees are non-refundable.

exhibits.quote: There will be no refunds or credits for partial months of the Service or for periods in which your account remains active but you do not use the Service.
exhibits.argument: Money-back guarantee is limited by terms stating there will be no refunds or credits.
